title: SentinelHub · Flood-aware routing

description.pl: Analiza tras na własnych danych GeoJSON z prywatnymi przestrzeniami, trwałą historią SQLite i chronionymi importami OSM / Sentinel WMS.
description.en: Routing analysis with user-supplied GeoJSON, private workspaces, persistent SQLite history, and protected OSM / Sentinel WMS imports.

demo_url_note: Stable Tailscale Funnel handler on the existing public HTTPS listener. No visitor VPN or account required. New workspaces expire after 24 hours; external WMS imports are operator-only and currently unavailable.
data_mode_note: The screenshot and separate public example use labelled synthetic inputs. The application also accepts user data and actual provider imports.
